## Moved out of the sprint on 2026-10-14: netcode-cs-port

The open cards of sprint stream netcode-cs-port, moved out of the stopped sprint on 2026-10-14, one item per card. Landed cards of the stream are in git and are not listed. Each item names its card, its tier, its base branch and any pushed work to resume from.

### Cs netcode disconnect callback cannot reenter a clearing slot

Server.DisconnectClientInternal calls the callback at src/Server.cs:563 and clears the slot at 580-584; a re-entrant disconnect reaches ClientIndex[-1] at :580 and throws IndexOutOfRangeException, and a callback with no self-guard recurses to an uncatchable StackOverflow.

Why it waits: Moved out of the stopped sprint on 2026-10-14: neither rocketnet nor v1.3 work.

From: sprint card cs-netcode-disconnect-callback-cannot-reenter-a-clearing-slot (stream netcode-cs-port, column working, tier pro, base sprint/netcode-cs-port), moved out of the sprint 2026-10-14

### Cs netcode client refuses a server address it has no socket for

The port never touches a closed descriptor (`socketIpv4?.` at src/Netcode.cs:1990, 1994; null checks at src/Client.cs:508-517) but silently drops sends, and Connect and ConnectToNextServer (src/Client.cs:348-349, 630-631) never skip the address or set InvalidConnectToken.

Why it waits: Moved out of the stopped sprint on 2026-10-14: neither rocketnet nor v1.3 work.
